mapper.select: SELECT id, type_code, name, sort_order, status, source_template_version, version FROM public.iam_org_type WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND status = 'ACTIVE' AND is_deleted = false ORDER BY sort_order, id
SELECT id, parent_type_id, child_type_id, version FROM public.iam_org_type_relation WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND is_deleted = false ORDER BY parent_type_id, child_type_id, id

SELECT DISTINCT parent.org_type_id AS parent_type_id, child.org_type_id AS child_type_id FROM public.iam_organization child JOIN public.iam_organization parent ON parent.tenant_id = child.tenant_id AND parent.id = child.parent_id AND parent.is_deleted = false WHERE child.tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND child.parent_id IS NOT NULL AND child.is_deleted = false
mapper.update: UPDATE public.iam_org_type_relation SET is_deleted = true, updated_by = #{operatorId}, updated_time = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, version = version + 1 WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND is_deleted = false
mapper.insert:
INSERT INTO public.iam_org_type_relation ( tenant_id, parent_type_id, child_type_id, created_by, updated_by ) VALUES
(#{tenantId}, #{relation.parentTypeId}, #{relation.childTypeId}, #{operatorId}, #{operatorId})
ON CONFLICT (tenant_id, parent_type_id, child_type_id) DO UPDATE SET is_deleted = false, updated_by = EXCLUDED.updated_by, updated_time = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, version = public.iam_org_type_relation.version + 1
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(1) FROM public.iam_org_type_relation relation JOIN public.iam_org_type parent_type ON parent_type.tenant_id = relation.tenant_id AND parent_type.id = relation.parent_type_id AND parent_type.status = 'ACTIVE' AND parent_type.is_deleted = false JOIN public.iam_org_type child_type ON child_type.tenant_id = relation.tenant_id AND child_type.id = relation.child_type_id AND child_type.status = 'ACTIVE' AND child_type.is_deleted = false WHERE relation.tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND relation.parent_type_id = #{parentTypeId} AND relation.child_type_id = #{childTypeId} AND relation.is_deleted = false
mapper.sql: organization.id, organization.parent_id, organization.org_type_id AS organization_type_id, organization_type.type_code, organization_type.name AS type_name, organization.business_code, organization.name, organization.admin_region_id, organization.own_status, CASE WHEN EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM public.iam_organization_closure effective_path JOIN public.iam_organization ancestor ON ancestor.tenant_id = effective_path.tenant_id AND ancestor.id = effective_path.ancestor_id AND ancestor.is_deleted = false WHERE effective_path.tenant_id = organization.tenant_id AND effective_path.descendant_id = organization.id AND effective_path.is_deleted = false AND ancestor.own_status = 'DISABLED' ) THEN 'DISABLED' ELSE 'ACTIVE' END AS effective_status, organization.path_version, EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM public.iam_organization child WHERE child.tenant_id = organization.tenant_id AND child.parent_id = organization.id AND child.is_deleted = false ) AS has_children, organization.version
mapper.select: SELECT FROM public.iam_organization organization JOIN public.iam_org_type organization_type ON organization_type.tenant_id = organization.tenant_id AND organization_type.id = organization.org_type_id AND organization_type.is_deleted = false WHERE organization.tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND organization.id = #{organizationId} AND organization.is_deleted = false LIMIT 1

SELECT FROM public.iam_organization organization JOIN public.iam_org_type organization_type ON organization_type.tenant_id = organization.tenant_id AND organization_type.id = organization.org_type_id AND organization_type.is_deleted = false WHERE organization.tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND organization.parent_id = #{parentId} AND organization.is_deleted = false ORDER BY organization.name, organization.id OFFSET #{offset} LIMIT #{limit}

SELECT organization.id, organization.parent_id, organization.org_type_id AS organization_type_id, organization_type.name AS type_name, organization.business_code, organization.name, CASE WHEN EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM public.iam_organization_closure effective_path JOIN public.iam_organization disabled_ancestor ON disabled_ancestor.tenant_id = effective_path.tenant_id AND disabled_ancestor.id = effective_path.ancestor_id AND disabled_ancestor.is_deleted = false WHERE effective_path.tenant_id = organization.tenant_id AND effective_path.descendant_id = organization.id AND effective_path.is_deleted = false AND disabled_ancestor.own_status = 'DISABLED' ) THEN 'DISABLED' ELSE 'ACTIVE' END AS effective_status, ( SELECT string_agg(ancestor.name, ' / ' ORDER BY path.depth DESC) FROM public.iam_organization_closure path JOIN public.iam_organization ancestor ON ancestor.tenant_id = path.tenant_id AND ancestor.id = path.ancestor_id AND ancestor.is_deleted = false WHERE path.tenant_id = organization.tenant_id AND path.descendant_id = organization.id AND path.is_deleted = false ) AS breadcrumb FROM public.iam_organization organization JOIN public.iam_org_type organization_type ON organization_type.tenant_id = organization.tenant_id AND organization_type.id = organization.org_type_id AND organization_type.is_deleted = false WHERE organization.tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND organization.is_deleted = false AND ( lower(organization.name) LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR lower(organization.business_code) LIKE CONCAT(#{keyword}, '%') ) ORDER BY organization.name, organization.id LIMIT #{limit}
mapper.update: UPDATE public.iam_organization SET org_type_id = #{organizationTypeId}, name = #{name}, normalized_name = #{normalizedName}, admin_region_id = #{adminRegionId}, updated_by = #{operatorId}, updated_time = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, version = version + 1 WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND id = #{organizationId} AND version = #{version} AND is_deleted = false

UPDATE public.iam_organization SET parent_id = #{newParentId}, path_version = path_version + 1, updated_by = #{operatorId}, updated_time = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, version = version + 1 WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND id = #{organizationId} AND parent_id IS NOT NULL AND version = #{version} AND is_deleted = false

WITH subtree AS ( SELECT descendant_id FROM public.iam_organization_closure WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND ancestor_id = #{organizationId} AND is_deleted = false ) UPDATE public.iam_organization_closure SET is_deleted = true, updated_by = #{operatorId}, updated_time = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, version = version + 1 WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND descendant_id IN (SELECT descendant_id FROM subtree) AND ancestor_id NOT IN (SELECT descendant_id FROM subtree) AND is_deleted = false

UPDATE public.iam_organization_closure SET is_deleted = true, updated_by = #{operatorId}, updated_time = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, version = version + 1 WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND (ancestor_id = #{organizationId} OR descendant_id = #{organizationId}) AND is_deleted = false
